format: OpenRC native software-rendered field performance v1

scope.wall: 1920x1080 post-draw render-loop intervals. First interval excluded on every launch.
scope.pool: ABBA on one VM per case/renderer. Each variant pool has 60 intervals from its two launches.
scope.viewport_cpu: Positive engine viewport CPU polls. GLES3 measures elapsed host ticks around viewport rendering, including waits. Poll age and uniqueness are unverified.
scope.viewport_gpu: Positive backend GPU polls only. Per-frame association, sample age and uniqueness are unverified.
scope.process: Direct Godot process sampled at 1 Hz across launch and teardown. Reported CPU seconds sum changes in user and system counters between sampled observations. RSS peak is the highest observed sample. Work and peaks between observations can be missed; each launch retains sampler coverage, stop reason and errors.
scope.memory: Engine-reported video allocations and sampled process RSS are different counters on shared system RAM.
scope.hardware: Mesa software rasterization. CPU model and core count were not recorded. Host kernel and architecture come from the input receipt. Compare each case within its own renderer/VM ABBA job.
